entry.title: Subsea HVDC Interconnectors, Critical Mineral Corridors, and Middle-Corridor Grid Sovereignty
entry.summary:
Cross-continental HVDC power cables and rare-earth refining corridors across the Black Sea, Caucasus, and Eastern Mediterranean are reshaping regional deterrence. Game-theoretic bargaining analysis shows that multi-nodal transit hubs reduce single-supplier coercion leverage by $54\%$ under winter peak-load stress scenarios.

Source: ECFR / EDAM Strategic Assessment · Tags: #energy-security #geopolitics #international-law
